source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of risk assessment and management (PDF 19).

blocks.text: Risk assessment aur management har software project ke bohat aham hisse hain. In mein woh mumkina khatre (risks) pehchane jate hain jo project ki kamyabi par asar dal sakte hain, yeh jaancha jata hai ke har khatra hone ka kitna imkaan hai aur us ka asar kitna hoga, aur un se nimatne ke tareeqe (strategies) banaye jate hain. Acha risk management project ko on track, budget ke andar aur quality standards ke mutabiq rakhta hai.
Risk Assessment aur Management ke steps

items: Risks pehchanein (Identify Risks): har woh khatra likhein jo project par asar dal sakta hai: technical risks (jaise technology ki tabdeeli), operational risks (jaise wasail ki kami) ya bahar ke risks (jaise market ka utaar charhao).
Risks ka jaiza (Analyze Risks): dekhein ke har khatra hone ka imkaan kitna hai aur project par us ka asar kitna hoga. Is se pata chalta hai ke kin risks par zyada tawajjo chahiye.

Kam karne ke tareeqe (Develop Mitigation Strategies): har bare khatre ke liye plan banayein jo us ka imkaan ya asar kam kare, jaise schedule mein gunjaish (buffer) rakhna, backup wasail rakhna ya zyada testing karna.
Nigrani aur jaiza (Monitor and Review): project par musalsal nazar rakhein ke naye risks to nahi aaye, aur purane risks ko dekh kar zaroorat ke mutabiq tareeqe badlein.

blocks.text: Misal: ek project nayi, na-aazmooda (untested) technology istemal kar raha hai. Khatra yeh hai ke technology tawaqqo ke mutabiq kaam na kare, jis se der ho aur zyada kharcha ho.

Mitigation Strategy (khatra kam karne ka tareeqa): technology ko main project mein poori tarah jorne se pehle ek chhota pilot project (aazmaishi project) chala kar test karein. Is se masle jaldi samne aa jate hain aur bare project ko nuqsan pohanchaye baghair un ko hal karne ka mauqa milta hai.

Discussion: kitab kehti hai ke ek figure risk management ka process dikhati hai: risks pehchanne se le kar nigrani aur jaize tak. In steps par chal kar project managers risks ko tarteeb se sambhal sakte hain aur project aasani se chalta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan Figure 1.8 ka hawala deti hai, lekin is chapter mein koi Figure 1.8 (aur Figure 1.7 bhi) chhapi hui nahi. Risk management ke steps wohi chaar numbered steps hain jo upar diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt: Risk assessment aur management ke main steps likhein aur software project mein un ki ahmiyat bataein. (Short Question 5)
blocks.explanation: 1) Risks pehchanna: koi aham khatra nazar andaz nahi hota. 2) Analyze: imkaan aur asar dekh kar sab se khatarnak risks par tawajjo. 3) Mitigation strategies: der aur zyada kharche ko hone se pehle kam karna (buffer, backup, zyada testing). 4) Monitor and review: project badalne par naye risks pakarna. Mil kar yeh project ko waqt par, budget ke andar aur quality ke mutabiq rakhte hain.

items: Risk management ke steps: identify, analyze, mitigation strategies, monitor and review.
Misal: nayi technology ko pehle chhote pilot project mein test karna.
